mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as the rate level is continuously observable.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) indicates a recessionary environment with aggressive monetary policy, which typically precedes a market recovery and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 9.0% (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), the market prices in a recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy transitions from recession to expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) is negative (year-over-year), it signals an economic contraction that triggers a market reaction anticipating a policy response and eventual recovery, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth < 0 (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 (index 2017=100), it indicates a significant contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes a market rebound as policymakers respond to the slowdown, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90 (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: The level of unemployment (UNRATE) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, meaning higher unemployment rates predict positive returns as the market anticipates a policy response and eventual economic recovery.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of trading days (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 3-month moving averages signals a broad-based consumer and housing sector slowdown, which typically precedes a market recovery and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST are both below their 3-month moving averages (p > 0.05 for one-tailed test against 50% positive returns).
